maddeler.e:
آتكل (form VIII)
# آتَكِلُ (ʔātakilu) /ʔaː.ta.ki.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِئْتَكَلَ (iʔtakala)
# آتَكِلَ (ʔātakila) /ʔaː.ta.ki.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِئْتَكَلَ (iʔtakala)
# آتَكِلْ (ʔātakil) /ʔaː.ta.kil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِئْتَكَلَ (iʔtakala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
